criteria.observation: All specified flags are registered under ctx setup. Guided prompts run only on a terminal; specified records skip terminal checks and input. Integrated setup connects a subsequent selector-free reader invocation and failures exit2.

Records manifests, original directory traversal, and roots are validated. Inputs rebase from nested cwd to relative shared paths or absolute personal paths. Symlinked config values retain their encountered base.

Dry-run is exact and write-free. Identical setup preserves bytes, inode, and mtime without creating a lock. Replacement retains unrelated metadata/body/workspaces, file permissions, personal keys, omitted aliases, and unrelated entries; summaries report removals.

Cooperating writers serialize using a persistent sidecar. Snapshot checks catch content/mode/inode/creation/symlink changes and late conflicting declarations. Injected create/write/short-write/chmod/sync/close/rename failures preserve the prior usable file and remove temporary files.
Real temporary filesystem coverage includes shared/personal setup, aliases, nested cwd, conflicts, dry-run, replacement, concurrent edits, and write failures.

reviewNotes: Root read setup plan preparation, serialization, atomic persistence, and factory tests. Root registered setupCommand and added a full-command setup-to-reader integration test.
Setup writes only the chosen configuration target plus its persistent lock sidecar. Dry-run/no-op create no directory or lock. Existing record bundles are never created or edited.
Snapshot detection covers changes observed before replacement; the sidecar coordinates ctx writers. No claim is made that arbitrary editors participate in the lock.
